title: AI-Brains opencode-hook payload
description: JSON payload passed to `ai-brains opencode-hook --payload`. Encodes an OpenCode session for message-only ingest from export-shaped JSON or SDK messages dump.

sessionId.description: OpenCode session id (`ses_…` or UUID). Used for delta-sync and turn-id namespace.

directory.description: Session working directory for project binding (after worktree).

worktree.description: Git worktree root; preferred over directory for project alias stability.

projectHash.description: Optional explicit project path/hash. Prefer worktree/directory when present.

parentId.description: When set, session is a child/subagent — hook skips ingest (skipped_child_session).

exportPath.description: Absolute path to export-shaped JSON `{info,messages}` (tests + export fallback).

messagesPath.description: Absolute path to SDK messages dump (export-shaped). Preferred over exportPath for live.
